strings.support_page_cycle_story: Ihe mere anyị ji eme nke a ↻
strings.support_story_1_body: Innioasis na-ewepụta ngwa ngwa ọhụrụ maka ndị egwuregwu dị ka Y1 (na-ezubere nhazigharị bọọdụ zoro ezo dị ka 6.0, 7.0, na 8.0) nke na-agbaji ngwa ngwa ochie. Nke ka njọ, ebe nrụọrụ weebụ ha na-enye ịdọ aka ná ntị efu na ohere efu na ngwa ngwa na-arụ ọrụ gara aga iji nwetaghachi na steeti brik. Mmelite na ọrụ Firmware Community na-eburu iberibe ndị a: anyị na-edobe ngwaahịa ngwaahịa ROM ọ bụla, nyochaa ngwaike gị ozugbo, wee mee ka onye ọkpụkpọ gị na-agba ọsọ n'enweghị nsogbu.
strings.support_story_1_headline: Mgbe ndị nrụpụta na-aga n'ihu, obodo na-agbago elu.
strings.support_story_1_item_1: Ịzọpụta ndị egwu gbajiri agbaji: Nleba nchekwa na-eme ka mmelite ọhụrụ bụrụ ngwaike ochie anaghị agba agba.
strings.support_story_1_item_2: ROM echekwabara: Nchịkọta ngwa ngwa ụlọ ọrụ izizi Innioasis ehichapụrụ.
strings.support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Ngwa na-egbuke egbuke maka macOS, Linux, na Windows.
strings.support_story_1_item_4: Akụrụngwa ngwaike: nchọpụta bọọdụ akpaka ka ị na-enweta ngwugwu ziri ezi mgbe niile.
strings.support_story_1_lead: Chebe ngwaọrụ gị pụọ na ọnyà ngwaike dị jụụ yana ngbanwe agbajiri.
strings.support_story_2_body: Isochi ngwa ngwa Innioasis gọọmentị na-apụtakarị ịza nzụkọ maka njikọ Google Drive kubiela, oke igwe ojii Baidu nwụrụ anwụ, yana faịlụ zip ihe omimi na-enweghị ngwa na-egbu maramara. Anyị wulitere netwọk mbudata a pụrụ ịdabere na ya, nke nwere onwe ya site na iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe SHA-256, ọkwa mmelite, yana nrụnye eduzi site na nzọụkwụ. Onyinye gị na-edobe nbudata na nnabata nke na-eme ka nke a kwe omume awa 24 kwa ụbọchị, ụbọchị 365 kwa afọ.
strings.support_story_2_headline: Enweghị draịva Google agbajiri agbaji. Enweghị ntule-ọrụ. Naanị firmware na-arụ ọrụ.
strings.support_story_2_item_1: Direct High Speed ​​CDN: Ngwa ngwa, nbudata ozugbo na-enweghị oke nbudata ma ọ bụ njikọ nwụrụ anwụ.
strings.support_story_2_item_2: Nwelite Ọkwa: Mara ọkwa ozugbo ewepụtara obodo ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ ndozi dara.
strings.support_story_2_item_3: Nwụnye nzọụkwụ-site-nzọụkwụ na-eduzi: Ọhụụ anya doro anya na-ejegharị gị site na ịpị bọtịnụ ọ bụla.
strings.support_story_2_item_4: Obodo nwere ọtụtụ asụsụ: Edebere ya nke ọma na Bekee, Chinese, German, Spanish, French & Japanese.
strings.support_story_2_lead: Akụrụngwa obodo akwadoro dị elu, ị nwere ike ịdabere na ya.
strings.support_story_3_body: Ngwa ngwa ụlọ nrụpụta ngwaahịa na-akpachapụ naanị ihe ngwaike Y1 ma ọ bụ Y2 nwere ike ime. Ndị obodo anyị wetara Rockbox, sistemu arụ ọrụ omenala dị fechaa, ọkpụkpọ codec audiophile na isiokwu omenala na ndụ. Anyị na-azụta mgbanwe ngwaike anụ ahụ na-apụ apụ iji nwalee, tụgharịa engineer, na nyochaa nrụnye ọ bụla. Na-akwado Mmelite na-akwụ ụgwọ maka nkeji ule ndị a ma na-eme ka mmepe ngwa ngwa ngwa ngwa.
strings.support_story_3_headline: Na-emepe ike zuru oke nke ọkpụkpọ Innioasis gị.
strings.support_story_3_item_1: Otu-pịa Rockbox: Ngwugharị audiophile na isiokwu omenala arụnyere na sekọnd.
strings.support_story_3_item_2: Firmware Community: nkwalite batrị, UI dị ọcha, yana nkwado codec ọdịyo ọgbara ọhụrụ.
strings.support_story_3_item_3: Lab Lab Akụrụngwa na-arụ ọrụ: Anyị na-anwale ngwaọrụ anụ ahụ n'ezie tupu anyị ahapụ ụlọ ọ bụla.
strings.support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% efu, sọftụwia mbụ nzuzo na-enweghị mgbasa ozi ma ọ bụ nsochi.
strings.support_story_3_lead: Na-eweta Rockbox, sistemụ arụmọrụ dị fechaa, yana nnwere onwe audiophile.
strings.support_story_4_body: Mgbe ụlọ ọrụ ngwaike gafere na ngwa ha na-esote, a na-ahapụ ụdị ochie. Innioasis anaghị enye nkwado Linux, enweghị ndekọ mgbanwe doro anya, yana ọ nweghị ụzọ dị mfe iji nwetaghachi mgbe nrụnye dara. Mmelite dị n'ihi na ndị ọrụ nwere mmụọ ekwesịghị ịtụfu ezigbo ihe egwu egwu. 100% nke onyinye obodo na-abanye ozugbo na idobe ngwa a oghe maka onye ọ bụla.
strings.support_story_4_headline: Nyere anyị aka ime ihe Innioasis anaghị eme.
strings.support_story_4_item_1: Nnapụta & Unbrick: egosipụtara mgbake na-aga ọbụlagodi mgbe ngwaọrụ jụrụ ịbute.
